name: Grendel Flats
worldBackground: A six-storey workers' block over a market street: twenty-four flats off a stair corridor.

zones.name: Sopwith Street
zones.description: the flats and the corner shop

zones.name: Tannery Yard
zones.description: the old tannery's scrap of yard

templates.name: Board bed
templates.description: A plain board bed with a folded blanket.
templates.physicalDescription: plain pine bed frame with grey blanket
templates.rule: along the wall of a sleeping room, never blocking a door

templates.name: Deal table
templates.description: A deal table with two chairs' worth of elbows.
templates.physicalDescription: scarred deal table with mismatched legs
templates.rule: by the window wall, clear of the door

templates.name: Kitchenette
templates.description: A two-ring cooker and a shallow sink.
templates.physicalDescription: enamelled two-ring cooker with pipe-fed sink
templates.rule: against the wall farthest from the door

templates.name: Shop counter
templates.description: A worn shop counter with a till.
templates.physicalDescription: scrolled counter front with brass till
templates.rule: facing the door, one stride in

templates.name: Shelf stack
templates.physicalDescription: plank shelves on brick ends, goods front-faced
templates.rule: along the walls, never blocking the door

rooms.name: Lobby
rooms.purpose: the stair lobby and its post

rooms.name: Sitting Room
rooms.purpose: the flat's sitting room and kitchen corner

npcs.name: Marta Cuyp
npcs.description: The block's concierge: keeps the stair rota and everyone's debts in one pencil ledger.
npcs.physicalDescription: stout concierge in a print dress with a pencil behind each ear

npcs.name: Eli Vosk
npcs.description: Runs the corner shop and half the gossip on the stair.
npcs.physicalDescription: young shopkeeper with a chalked apron and quick smile

player.name: Juniper Hale
player.description: A new tenant on the fourth floor, still learning the stair rota.
player.physicalDescription: new tenant in a bus-stained coat with a suitcase handle sticking out of a bag
